review_note: Measurement-change rules. The engine refuses to load this ruleset until review_status is set to 'CLINICALLY_REVIEWED' by qualified clinical stakeholders. Threshold fields (delta/percent_delta) are intentionally left EMPTY: they must be filled in during clinical review. No default clinical thresholds are shipped. Trend evaluation is a deterministic arithmetic check on stored measurements — it is NOT machine learning and produces monitoring prompts, never diagnoses.

categories.ATTENTION: A notable measurement change was detected; mention it at the next contact
categories.HIGH_CONCERN: A clinically reviewed measurement change threshold was crossed; contact a healthcare professional promptly

messages.ATTENTION: A notable change in a stored measurement was detected between visits. Please mention it at the next contact.
messages.HIGH_CONCERN: A reviewed measurement-change threshold was crossed between visits. Please contact a healthcare professional promptly.
